dr-recursion: Launches the Dr. Recursion collection script.
sign: Applies an Authenticode signature to files using the configured signing certificate.
bom: Inspects or modifies text-file encoding and byte-order marks.
paintshop: Navigates to the Paintshop workspace and lists its contents.
say: Writes formatted console text with configurable color and icon.
hydrate: Reads file contents with optional encoding, raw output, or tail selection.
web: Opens or launches web resources using available local tools.
wake: Surveys project directories and provides an interactive project-selection workflow.
fu: Provides an interactive Git workflow. Review its implementation before using it.
unzip: Extracts an archive to a selected destination.
zip: Creates a compressed archive from a selected path.
paint: Interactive utility; detailed behavior has not yet been documented.
t: Opens a ticket-related resource using a supplied ticket identifier.
Wake-Fractal: Fractal workspace helper; detailed behavior has not yet been documented.
pipe2vbox: VirtualBox-related helper; detailed behavior has not yet been documented.
